SELF_AUDIT.NormalMapBoundary: The generated 32-byte mesh layout intentionally omits tangents. Normal atlas textures may be emitted as offline artifacts, but `_BumpMap`, `_NormalMap`, and `_NORMALMAP` are not bound until a tangent-bearing layout is explicitly authorized.
SELF_AUDIT.ScalabilityCurve: LOD ratios, mock clutter elongation, small-detail collapse, generated LODGroup screen thresholds, and atlas tile caps are lerped/clamped from CSV profile values. Below 0.3 the bake keeps atlas indirection but collapses tiny triangles toward centers, emits cheaper LOD2, and lowers LOD residency so the room sheds dense geometry earlier; above 0.7 it retains denser LODs, longer LOD0/LOD1 residency, larger tiles, source texture copy fidelity, and linear normal/mask atlas data without changing runtime code paths. Overflow materials use a reserved 16px fallback tile instead of corrupting packed atlas regions.
SELF_AUDIT.HPhiVaultStatus: No runtime manager, no private persistent runtime NativeArray, no StateRingBuffer route. Per-bake black-box rings are explicitly reset after uninitialized allocation, use deterministic local frame indices, record failing prefab hashes before exception dumps, dump recorded entries only before wrap, dump chronological retained entries after wrap, and include written-entry counts in the reason sidecar. BakeFolder owns one reusable InteriorClutterBakeScratch for static segments, preserved interactives, materials, mesh filters, shared materials, and component probes, then clears it per prefab and after prefab unload. Interactive filter scratch lists are caller-owned transaction locals, not static global buffers; tag/layer filters are fixed token lists instead of string arrays. Atlas texture property lookup avoids params-array allocation in the material loop. The mesh ABI facade writes VertexAttributeDescriptor records into a disposed Temp NativeArray and validates with direct Mesh accessors instead of allocating mesh-attribute arrays. Generated atlases receiving GPU copies are synchronized to CPU texture data before asset serialization. Tinted albedo materials use a top-mip temp tile plus TintAtlasTileJob multiply path; AtlasTintFallback is reserved for failed tint copy. Exact-size Graphics.CopyTexture failures retry through an RT blit before AtlasCopyFailure. Mask atlas source texture copy accepts only `_MaskMap`; Standard `_MetallicGlossMap` uses scalar fallback packing until channel-aware repack exists. Generated atlas Texture2D assets are editor-compressed before asset publication with BC5 normals where supported and BC7/DXT5 fallback for color/mask channels. Generated asset replacements are marked dirty and flushed once after prefab/mock publication. Generated assets are immutable environment data.

Job.name: ExtractClutterUInt16Job/ExtractClutterUInt32Job
Job.consumes: MeshData byte streams, validated attribute windows, baseVertex-adjusted bounded index stream, triangle-aligned counts, bounded destination windows
Job.handle: completed before MeshData disposal inside editor transaction

Job.name: TransformAndAppendVerticesJob
Job.consumes: source vertices, segments, guarded segment map, precomputed inverse-transpose normal basis
Job.outputs: pre-sized NativeArray<InteriorClutterRawVertex> windows or fallback vertices for invalid segment ids

Job.name: DecimateTriangleSoupJob
Job.consumes: LOD0 raw vertices, source/output length windows, finite position guards
Job.outputs: LOD1/LOD2 raw vertices or deterministic fallback triangles
Job.handle: LOD1 and LOD2 scheduled with transformHandle then CombineDependencies completes once before serialization

Job.name: TintAtlasTileJob
Job.consumes: readback albedo tile pixels and material tint
Job.outputs: tinted Texture2D tile copied into atlas
Job.handle: completed before tile Apply and CopyTexture

Job.name: FillAtlasSolidJob/FillAtlasRectColorsJob
Job.consumes: rect/color DTOs, rect/color length windows, overflow-safe rect clamps
Job.handle: rectFillHandle depends on solidFillHandle; completed before Texture2D.SetPixelData

SELF_AUDIT.DearLie: Texture atlas UV remap includes material tiling/offset, overflow materials are contained to a reserved fallback tile, GPU-copied source texture data is committed before asset serialization, tinted albedo textures are multiplied offline into atlas tiles when possible, Standard metallic maps avoid false mask-channel ownership, the 32-byte no-tangent material path does not bind tangent-space normals, and triangle-soup LOD collapse replaces runtime prop logic with immutable presentation geometry.
